This update brings Japanese translation to No Extra Regrets (thanks to [url=https://translation-gorochan.memo.wiki/]GORO-CHAN[/url])

In addition to that, there have been some small tweaks to the story, one new character graphic added and various small fixes, in addition to two new achievements

notes.content:

In addition, the gender selection title/start game buttons are larger now.

The main update is still on schedule for the end of October

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
The last CG graphics have now been started, and with any luck, should be completed early September.  Before that, one last character graphic will be added.

Hopefully, the title sequence will be ready before mid-September, but if not, the game will just to be released later.
